ST-03.title: Audit colliding backlog IDs (BLG-QA-72)
ST-03.notes: AC-01: classified all 39 IDs with >1 '### BLG-xxx' header — 29 were compliant §6.1 stub+verbatim archive pairs (not collisions), 10 were true collisions (different items sharing one ID), 5 were the same item archived twice under two historical conventions (duplicate record, not a collision). AC-02: 10 true collisions renumbered in backlog_archive.md with traceability notes (BLG-FE-66/67 -> BLG-FE-85/86; BLG-GOV-69/70/71/72/73/74 -> BLG-GOV-161/162/163/164/165/166; BLG-OPS-12/13 -> BLG-OPS-86/87); no ID reused. The 5 duplicate-archival-record IDs were NOT renumbered (not a collision) — filed as BLG-QA-74 for Product Owner confirmation before any dedup, per backlog_management_prompt.md §6.2 and backlog_archive.md's append-only policy. AC-03 partial: backlog_management_prompt.md STEP 4.5 fixed (v1.9->v1.10) to stop false-flagging the 29 compliant §6.1 pairs as duplicates (root cause of 'pre-existing duplicate IDs' noted at last groom backlog run) — next groom backlog run will show 0 unresolved duplicates for the 10 renumbered IDs, but will still correctly flag the 5 BLG-QA-74 items pending PO decision. This is an honest partial AC-03 outcome, not a full '0 unresolved' state, because full resolution requires PO sign-off per governance policy — engine could not unilaterally delete archive content.

ST-04.title: database.py / _DB_STUB_FUNCTIONS manual-sync risk (BLG-QA-73)
ST-04.notes: AC-01: automated derivation ADOPTED. Investigation found the existing manual _DB_STUB_FUNCTIONS list had already drifted from reality (8 names imported by backend services but missing from the stub; 9 stale names no longer imported anywhere) — confirming the manual-sync risk was real, not theoretical. AC-02: replaced the manual list with an AST scan of backend/ for 'from database import (...)' statements (vendored/.venv paths explicitly excluded after discovering backend/.venv/lib/.../pip/_vendor/distlib/database imports were false positives). Verified locally: full pytest suite produces identical pass/fail/error counts before and after the change (53 failed/171 passed/14 skipped/7 errors, matching pre-existing environment gaps unrelated to this change — missing yfinance package); the auto-derived list correctly picks up all 8 previously-missing names. A live CI run on push will provide the formal verification referenced in the AC. AC-03: CLAUDE.md rule retired and replaced with a note describing the automated derivation.

ST-02.title: Red Flag Journal filter state persistence (BLG-FE-40)
ST-02.notes: Reclassified delegated_frontend -> autonomous at STEP 3.1 (LL-v2.3-CL-01 default: frontend stories are autonomous unless genuinely incapable; no delegation record had yet been created, so no Cancelled DEL entry required). User (acting in Product Owner capacity) confirmed this reclassification this session; ST-01 kept delegated_frontend since it requires Head of UX & Design visual judgment. AC-01: filter state (eventTypeFilter, tickerFilter, sinceFilter) persisted to localStorage key 'redFlagJournal.filters' with a {version, data} envelope, restored via lazy useState initializer on mount. AC-02: version-mismatch or corrupt/unparseable stored payload is caught, the stale key is removed, and defaults are used -- no error surfaces (verified in SC-RFJ-05b). AC-03: Playwright test added covering set-filter -> reload -> restored (SC-RFJ-05a) and the stale-state clearing path (SC-RFJ-05b). New tests were placed in a new file tests/e2e/red-flag-journal-filter-persistence.spec.js rather than appended to the existing tests/e2e/red-flag-journal.spec.js, because that existing file is excluded from CI via playwright.config.js testIgnore (BLG-QA-64 -- pre-existing, unrelated UI-text-mismatch failures, confirmed by running it directly: SC-RFJ-01/02 fail on a getByText('Red Flag Journal') strict-mode collision with the nav link, unrelated to this change). No spec deviation: docs/specs/frontend/pages/red_flag_journal.md does not document persistence behaviour at all (silent on this point), so this is Case B (documentation-creation) territory for spec_references but no textual deviation to file against the doc.
